opportunities.title: N-able's Patch Didn't Patch: Inside the N-central Flaw That CISA Just Added to KEV
opportunities.why_now: A single N-able N-central auth-bypass bug went from 'patched' to 'exploited' to 'CISA KEV' to 'attackers still taking over servers' in under a week, making it the textbook inevitable-breach timeline.
opportunities.angle: Timeline/postmortem format tracking the escalation across four separate reports, ending with a 'what MSPs running N-central need to do right now' checklist.

opportunities.title: Your Passkey Isn't as Unphishable as You Think: The Pass-ta-key Attack on Google's Sync
opportunities.why_now: New malware technique hijacks Google-synced passkeys, directly undercutting the industry's 'passwordless = safe' marketing right as passkey adoption is peaking.
opportunities.angle: Myth-busting explainer: how the attack works, which platforms are exposed, and why 'passkey' was never a synonym for 'unstealable credential.'

opportunities.title: AI Agents Are Attacking Each Other Now: Gemini, DeepSeek, and OpenAI's Bad Week
opportunities.why_now: Three separate incidents in 72 hours — Gemini agent-to-agent secret leaks, a weaponized DeepSeek agent hitting a security firm, and Anthropic defending Claude — show agentic AI has become an active attack surface, not a hypothetical one.
opportunities.angle: Trend roundup connecting the dots across vendors with a pull-quote from Schneier's 'genie is out of the bottle' framing, positioned as the CISO briefing memo.

opportunities.title: Device Code Phishing Is Up 1,500% — Here's Why Your MFA Didn't Stop It
opportunities.why_now: A 1,500% spike is the kind of stat that demands explanation, and most defenders still don't understand how device-code auth flows bypass the MFA they trust.
opportunities.angle: Explainer with attack-flow diagram description and detection tips, framed as 'the phishing technique your SOC playbook forgot about.'

opportunities.title: The BMC Bug That's Been Hiding in Your Data Center for Decades
opportunities.why_now: A newly disclosed decades-old BMC vulnerability exposes thousands of data centers, a reminder that firmware-layer debt is the industry's longest-running unpatched liability.
opportunities.angle: 'How did this survive this long' investigative angle, tying it to broader firmware/BMC patch-cadence failures and naming affected vendors/scale.
